description:
Checks whether a gift code is currently valid for a player without consuming or preparing it.
Use when: showing an early validity message; horizon_prepare_gift_code prepares a consumable V2 identity.
Not for: claiming rewards (use horizon_redeem_gift_code with an already persisted intent).
Requires: userId from horizon_signup_* or horizon_signin_*; no session token.
Side effects: None (read only).
Returns: {valid}; a validity check reserves nothing and cannot recover an uncertain redemption.
Errors: Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

code.description: Original visible gift code, retained with the prepared campaign identity

userId.description: Player user ID (UUID) from horizon_signup_* or horizon_signin_*

name: horizon_validate_gift_code

anyOf.description: true when the player can redeem the code now

title: Validate Gift Code
